entities.summary: Norman Garstin was an Irish artist, teacher, art critic and journalist associated with the Newlyn School of painters. After completing his studies in Antwerp and Paris, Garstin travelled around Europe and painted some of his first professional paintings while on the journey. He later took students to Europe to some of his favourite places. Norman Garstin was a writers & intellectuals from County Limerick (1847-08-28, County Limerick–1926-06-22). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
